left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient has provided written informed consent
-  Patient is a planned recipient of a living donor kidney transplant

right.raw_text: -  Patient is a planned recipient of an ABO blood group-compatible kidney graft

left.raw_text: -  Patient is a planned recipient of a kidney graft from a donor that is not HLA (human leukocyte antigen)-identical

right.raw_text: -  Patient is negative for DSA (donor-specific antibodies)

left.raw_text: -  WOCBP (women  [AND] of child-bearing potential) must have a negative pregnancy test at inclusion

right.raw_text: -  WOCBP must be using an adequate method of contraception to avoid pregnancy throughout the study  [AND] and for up to 12 weeks after the study in such a manner that the risk of pregnancy is minimized

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient is EBV (epstein barr virus)-negative on serology

right.raw_text: -  Patient is HIV- [OR] positive or suffering from chronic viral hepatitis

left.raw_text: -  Patient is CMV (cytomegalo virus) [AND] -negative and receiving a kidney from a CMV-positive donor
-  Patient with prior kidney transplant  [OR] or non-renal solid organ transplant

right.raw_text: -  Patient has a known contraindication to any of the protocol-specified treatments

left.raw_text: -  Patient had been diagnosed with a malignancy within 5 years prior to study entry, excluding non-metastatic basal  [OR] or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin

right.raw_text: -  Female  [AND] patients with a positive pregnancy test
